notes: One PNG per id at art/generated/<id>.png. art/ART.md is the style authority. 'keyed' register (v2, 2026-09-24, see ART.md) = crisp top-down dark-fantasy RPG character sprites, chunky proportions, thick clean near-black outline (12-16 px at 1024 px), 3-tone cel shading with a watercolour wash texture inside the flat fills, upper-left key light, flat pure #0000FF background, no floor/shadow pool/text/glow, subject facing right, tag visible in the silhouette, must read at 48 px (hero) / 32-48 px (monster). gen = generation size (1024 short edge for units). master_h = pack.py resample height (2x runtime texel height). texel_h = runtime sprite-texel height. Environment tiles are NOT here: art/make_tiles.py owns them. Register 3 (env_*): bg 'env' (opaque tile) / 'env_keyed' (alpha decal or prop) — Codex pixel-art sources for the 16x16 environment, converted by art/make_env.py (box downscale to `texels`, luminance -> biome ramp index, per-biome tiles into art/tiles/); not packed as sprites.

assets.description: Full-body anime fighter, young and squarely built, facing right in a ready stance: round wooden shield on the left arm, short broad sword held low in the right hand, dented steel breastplate over a crimson tunic, cropped dark hair, determined anime face with large eyes. Warm steel + crimson cloth so the silhouette reads 'shield and sword' at 48 px. (Hero looks, 2026-09-25: this id is the default-look alias, a copy of hero_fighter_male; the class's looks are hero_fighter_{male,female,cat}.)

Full-body anime rogue, slight and quick, facing right in a low forward crouch: hooded charcoal-and-plum half-cloak, one dagger held reversed and low, a small throwing knife in the other hand, pale bone sash, sharp anime face under the hood with a lock of hair escaping. Low diagonal silhouette, clearly distinct from the fighter's upright shield bulk at 48 px. (Hero looks, 2026-09-25: this id is the default-look alias, a copy of hero_rogue_female; the class's looks are hero_rogue_{male,female,cat}.)

Full-body anime ranger, lean and long-limbed, facing right, standing tall with a longbow held out in front in the left hand (the bow's arc taller than the torso, bowstring visible, a nocked arrow half-drawn by the right hand), a full quiver of fletched arrows angled up over the right shoulder, deep-green hooded cloak with the hood UP shading a calm anime face with large eyes and a long braid escaping the hood, moss-and-leather tunic, tall boots. Muted forest green + warm leather + bone-white fletching so the silhouette reads 'tall bow, hood, quiver' at 48 px; clearly distinct from the fighter's shield bulk and the rogue's low crouch. (Hero looks, 2026-09-25: this id is the default-look alias, a copy of hero_ranger_female; the class's looks are hero_ranger_{male,female,cat}.)

Full-body anime caster, slender, facing right in a poised upright stance: a tall gnarled staff held upright in the right hand, taller than the head, with a small bright ember-orange crystal at its tip painted as a jewel-bright flat shape (a lit crystal, NOT a glow halo, NOT a light bloom, NOT blue), long layered robes in dusty violet and ivory falling to the ankles with a wide hem, a soft hood raised over long pale hair that spills out as flowing anime locks, NO wizard hat, NO beard, the free left hand open at the hip with fingers spread. Violet + ivory + one warm ember accent so the silhouette reads 'tall staff with a bright tip, long robes, hood' at 48 px; clearly distinct from the fighter, rogue and ranger. (Hero looks, 2026-09-25: this id is the default-look alias, a copy of hero_caster_male; the class's looks are hero_caster_{male,female,cat}.)

A single big dungeon RAT seen from the SIDE, facing right, the body stretched LONG and low (the body is twice as long as it is tall): a fat umber-grey furry body, a pointed snout with a pink nose and one small black eye, big round pink ears, four short pink feet, and a long thick bare pink TAIL trailing behind in a single curve. Chunky, readable, one long horizontal mass. Tag: the long body and the tail - reads as 'rat' at 20 px tall.

A lean dungeon jackal facing right mid-lope: low horizontal body, ribs showing, big pointed ears, narrow snout with a snarl, tail straight out behind. Sandy-tan and dusty umber washes, one flat shadow mass. Tag: LOW, LEAN and FAST — the silhouette is a stretched horizontal dash with ears. Reads at 32 px.

A small hunched goblin facing right: big head, pointed ears, wide grin, pot belly, holding a crude short cleaver up at shoulder height, rag loincloth and a scrap of leather. Olive-green skin, ochre rags, one jewel-bright accent (red cloth). Upright, compact, simple silhouette; reads 'goblin with cleaver' at 40 px.

A goblin archer facing right, DRAWING A BOW: tall crude recurve bow held out front with the string pulled fully back to the cheek and an arrow nocked, quiver on the back. Same olive skin and ochre rags as the plain goblin, plus a leather cap. The drawn bow is the tag — it must be a big clear arc in the silhouette at 40 px, wider than the body.

A goblin conjurer facing right: same olive goblin build, wrapped in a tattered violet robe with a bone-fetish hood, both arms raised holding a gnarled staff overhead; two small pale ghost-blades hover just above the staff tip. Tag: raised staff + hovering blades, readable as a T-shape with sparks at 40 px. Blades are ivory/teal-white, never saturated blue.

A goblin CAPTAIN facing right, a head taller and broader than a plain goblin, with BRIGHT MOSS-GREEN / LEAF-GREEN SKIN exactly like the green goblins in watch.png (saturated green, NOT grey, NOT olive-grey): dented iron half-helm with two short horns, a battered war HORN raised to its mouth in one hand (it summons), a notched short sword low in the other, a small scale-mail vest (keep the green arms, face and legs dominant), a red sash. Tag: the raised horn and the horned helm - 'the goblin that calls the others' at 48 px.

A mischievous dungeon monkey facing right, mid-scamper on three limbs, CLUTCHING A STOLEN BULGING SACK in one arm against its chest, long tail curled up in a question mark, cheeky anime grin. Umber-brown fur with a pale belly, the sack in ochre with a red tie. Tag: the sack and the tail. Reads at 32 px.

A HUGE wide ogre facing right, winding up: massive rounded shoulders, small head, barrel gut, a great tree-trunk club raised high over its head with both hands. Dull grey-umber skin, ragged hide kilt, tusks. Tag: HUGE and heavy, the club overhead. The silhouette is a broad mass much wider than a goblin; reads at 48 px.

A bloat: one swollen, taut, floating sac of sickly yellow-green gas, veined, with a few tiny dangling tendrils and a small puckered mouth. No limbs, no face beyond the mouth. Tag: SWOLLEN SAC — a single fat teardrop/balloon silhouette, glowing faintly from within. Reads as 'balloon about to pop' at 40 px. Yellow-green, never blue.

A pink jelly: a low translucent quivering blob of rose-pink watercolour, dome-shaped with a wobbly lower edge, a few suspended darker pink flecks inside, a wet highlight upper-left. No face, no limbs. Tag: TRANSLUCENT BLOB — a squat dome silhouette. Reads at 32 px. Pink, magenta and ivory only.

A dungeon eel facing right: long thick S-curved body rising as if out of water, jaws open with needle teeth, small fin ridge along the back, tail trailing off lower-left. Dark olive-teal back and ivory belly (teal must be high-green, never royal blue). Tag: the long S-curve. Reads as a sinuous ribbon with a mouth at 32 px.

A walking skeleton warrior facing right: all bone, upright, ribcage and skull clearly drawn, holding a rusted notched sword, a few rags of grave-cloth. Bone-white paper with warm ivory washes and one flat indigo shadow side; dark ink between every bone. Tag: ALL BONE — the gappy ribcage silhouette. Reads at 48 px.

A ghoul facing right: hunched, gaunt, grey-green corpse flesh, arms out front ending in long clawed hands, jaw hanging open, hair in lank strands. Tag: HUNCHED with CLAWS reaching forward — the silhouette leans forward with two claw shapes leading. Distinct from the upright skeleton at 40 px.

A wraith facing right: a tall floating tattered shroud with no legs, the hem torn into trailing ribbons, a hooded void where the face should be with two pale points of light, long thin reaching hand. Ash-violet and blue-black washes (all channels low, never saturated blue), ivory-pale edges. Tag: TATTERED and FLOATING — ragged hem, no feet. Reads at 48 px.

A captive facing right: an anime adventurer kneeling or slumped with heavy iron manacles and a thick chain visibly wrapping the wrists and trailing to the floor edge of the figure, torn tunic, hopeful anime face looking up. Warm ivory skin, dull red tunic, iron-grey chain with ink links. Tag: IN CHAINS — the chain must be a bold dark line in the silhouette at 48 px. No floor drawn.

The Goblin Warlord facing right, LARGER than any goblin, with BRIGHT MOSS-GREEN / LEAF-GREEN SKIN exactly like the green goblins in watch.png (saturated green face, arms and hands - NOT grey, NOT olive-grey; the green skin must be the dominant colour of the sprite): broad, bare muscular green arms, a fur mantle and a few scavenged iron plates, a jagged iron CROWN, a huge cleaver in one hand and a raised fist in the other, a red war-banner strip trailing. Green skin, dark iron, red banner. Tag: BOSS - crowned, big, banner. Reads as 'the big crowned green goblin' at 64 px.

The Bloat Mother: an enormous swollen sac of sickly yellow-green gas, ringed with a crown of bone spines around the top, dozens of tiny bloat-buds budding from her sides, a wide puckered maw, taut veins. Tag: BOSS — huge, spine-crowned, budding. The silhouette is a giant balloon with a spiky crown; reads at 64 px. Yellow-green and bone, never blue.

The Lich facing right: a tall gaunt robed skeleton king in tattered indigo-black robes with a tall bone SKULL-CROWN, one hand raising a crooked staff topped with a pale skull, the other hand open with a cold teal-white flame. Bone-white skull, blue-black robes (all channels low, never saturated blue), teal-white flame. Tag: BOSS — crowned skull, staff, flame. Reads at 64 px.

A spectral blade: a single floating ghost-sword, point down, ivory-white and pale teal watercolour, no hilt-holder, a faint trailing wisp. Bold ink outline. Tag: a floating sword. Reads as a vertical blade at 24 px. Never saturated blue.

A spectral hound facing right: a lean running dog made of ivory-white and pale teal wash, hind legs fading into wisps, ears back, mouth open. Bold ink outline. Tag: a ghostly running dog. Reads at 24 px. Never saturated blue.

An iron golem facing right, MASSIVE and boxy: a walking stack of thick riveted iron plates — slab shoulders wider than it is tall at the top, a small visor-slit head sunk between them, block forearms, stubby plated legs, a broad chest plate. Rust-red and dull steel-grey iron with dry-brush rust bloom, a few ember-orange seams between the plates painted as flat bright cracks (no glow). Tag: MASSIVE IRON PLATES — the silhouette is a squared-off stepped block, all right angles, clearly not the rounded ogre. Reads at 48 px.

A forge imp facing right, SMALL, mid-hop with knees tucked: a scrawny imp with solid ember-orange skin and soot-black hands, feet and horn tips, ONE small flame tuft of hair only (the body is flesh, NOT made of fire), a wide toothy grin, HOLDING OUT A STOLEN POTION BOTTLE in both arms in front of its chest — a big round-bellied flask of PALE BONE-WHITE / IVORY glass with a brown cork, the glass EMPTY or holding only a thin line of liquid at the bottom (the flask must read WHITE, not red: no red or orange inside the flask), one third of the imp's height, separated from the body by a full ink contour so it is its own shape. The bottle is the palest, brightest thing in the sprite. Orange + soot-black + bone-white glass + one red accent. Tag: SMALL, WITH A STOLEN BOTTLE — at 28 px the bottle must be a distinct pale round bump on the front of the silhouette. No fire on the ground, no flames around the body.

A bell sentinel facing right, upright and stiff: an iron-armoured humanoid whose entire HEAD IS A LARGE BRONZE BELL — the flared bell mouth opening downward over the shoulders, wider than the body, a dark clapper visible hanging inside it; a slender riveted body beneath, one arm raised holding a striking rod ready to ring. Tarnished bronze-gold bell, iron-grey body, one ember-orange seam accent. Tag: A BELL FOR A HEAD — the top of the silhouette is a bell shape, unmistakable at 40 px. No sound lines, no glow.

A slag crawler facing right: a LOW, long, many-legged creature of cooled black slag crust cracked open along the back to show ember-orange heat beneath (flat bright cracks, no glow), a blunt heavy head low to the front, six short stubby legs, and a TRAIL OF EMBERS behind it — a scatter of small orange and yellow flecks attached to the tapering tail end, drawn as part of the silhouette. Soot-black + ember-orange + one hot yellow accent. Tag: LOW and TRAILING EMBERS — a horizontal dash with a dotted ember tail. Reads at 32 px. No floor.

A foundry smith facing right, stocky and broad: a burly bare-armed figure in a heavy leather APRON down to the shins, a massive square-headed HAMMER raised in both hands over the shoulder, a soot-streaked face with a set anime jaw and a headband, thick gloves, boots. Warm leather browns, iron-grey hammer head, one ember-orange accent (a hot rivet on the apron pocket). Tag: HAMMER AND APRON — the raised square hammer and the long apron rectangle are the silhouette at 40 px. Clearly not a goblin, clearly not the golem.

The Foundry Master facing right, LARGER than the iron golem: a colossal iron-and-bronze forge-lord, riveted plate body like the golem but with an ANVIL-SHAPED chest, a heavy leather apron over the plates, a jagged CROWN of iron rivet-spikes on the helm, a gigantic two-handed forge hammer raised overhead, ember-orange seams at every joint (flat bright cracks, no glow). Rust-red iron, bronze, leather, one hot yellow accent in the crown's centre. Tag: BOSS — crowned, huge hammer, apron over iron. Reads as 'the big crowned iron smith' at 64 px.

A lurker facing right, hunched: a pallid bone-white cave-thing with NO EYES — a smooth blank brow above a wide lipless mouth of needle teeth, a long neck craned forward, and ARMS FAR LONGER THAN ITS BODY that reach down past its feet, ending in long thin fingers. Skinny torso, knees bent. Bone-white and pale grey washes, blue-black shadow side (all channels low, never saturated blue). Tag: EYELESS and LONG-ARMED — the silhouette is a hunched body with two arms hanging to the bottom edge. Reads at 40 px.

A deep eel facing right: a very long, thin RIBBON of a fish undulating in three waves across the frame, a continuous translucent fin frill along the whole back, a narrow head with a needle jaw at the right, a tapering ribbon tail at the left. Ink-black back, bone-white belly and frill, a few pale teal flecks along the flank (high green, never royal blue). Tag: A RIBBON — thin and wavy with many curves, clearly different from the thick S-curved fens eel. Reads at 32 px.

A cave troll facing right: HUNCHED BULK — an enormous rounded back and shoulders, a small head sunk low in front of the chest, both long thick arms reaching down with knuckles at ankle level, short bowed legs, no weapon. Mottled slate-grey and moss-green hide with wart-lumps, a pale belly, blue-black shadow mass (never saturated blue). Tag: HUNCHED BULK — the silhouette is a big boulder with knuckles under it, clearly not the upright club-raising ogre. Reads at 48 px.

A siren facing right, standing and SINGING: a slender figure in a long robe whose HEAD IS THROWN BACK — chin up, face to the ceiling, mouth wide open — with the deep hood fallen back off the face onto the shoulders, both hands clasped at the chest, the robe hem pooled at the feet; THREE BOLD flat ink voice-arcs stacked in front of the open mouth (each as thick as the contour line and a head-width wide, flat shapes, no glow). Bone-white face and throat, deep violet-black robe (all channels low, never saturated blue), a pale teal lining inside the fallen hood. Tag: HOODED SINGER — the thrown-back open-mouthed head and the voice-arcs are the silhouette at 40 px. Distinct from the floating wraith: this one stands. Not a hooded figure looking down. RETRY NOTE (v2): the last attempt came back as a hooded standing figure — wrong. NO HOOD AT ALL: bare head with long flowing hair, the whole head TILTED BACK so the face points at the ceiling, mouth open wide in song, both arms spread wide and low, and THREE thick pale sound-arcs rising from the open mouth. The upturned face and the arcs must be the top of the silhouette.

A mirror shade facing right: a HERO-SHAPED DARK MIRROR — the full-body silhouette of an anime adventurer in a ready stance with a short sword held low, painted as a flat solid blue-black shape (all channels low, never saturated or royal blue) with thin silvered cyan-white edge highlights along the upper-left contours (green channel at least as high as blue), NO face, NO features, one pale crack running across the chest. Bold dark ink outline as always. Tag: A HERO SHAPE, BUT DARK — at 48 px it must read as 'the hero's shadow'. RETRY NOTE (v2): the last attempt lost the sword and read as a dark blob. Make it a clear standing HUMAN hero silhouette in a wide fighting stance (legs apart, visible), a LONG straight sword held out low and forward so the blade sticks out past the body, a short half-cloak; the body blue-black with bright cyan-white edge light along the top and left edges so the shape reads.

The Lurker Queen facing right, LARGER than any lurker: a huge pallid eyeless matriarch, blank brow, wide needle-toothed maw, a tall CROWN of bone spines growing from her skull, FOUR long thin arms reaching down and out, a swollen belly, and three small lurker-hatchlings clinging to her flanks and shoulders. Bone-white and grey washes, blue-black shadow side (never saturated blue), one pale teal accent in the crown. Tag: BOSS — crowned, eyeless, many long arms, hatchlings. Reads at 64 px.

A sanctum warden facing right, tall and upright in pale stone-white plate armour with gold trim and a slate-grey tabard: a tall rectangular TOWER SHIELD held out in FRONT (to the right, covering knees to chin), and a LONGBOW slung across the BACK so its arc pokes clearly above the left shoulder and below the hip behind the figure, a full quiver beside it. Closed great-helm. Ivory-white, gold, slate. Tag: SHIELD IN FRONT, BOW ON THE BACK — both must be distinct bumps of the silhouette at 48 px.

A sanctum acolyte facing right, BOWED: a robed figure bent forward at the waist, head bowed low, both arms raised with open palms turned up at shoulder height (an offering gesture), a long white robe with gold hem trim and a slate-grey hood, bare feet. Ivory-white, one gold accent, slate shadow. Tag: BOWED, HANDS UP — a folded figure with two raised hands, clearly not the singing siren (whose head goes back) at 40 px.

An echo facing right: a slender pale humanoid in a plain ivory tunic drawn TWICE — the front figure solid, and an identical DOUBLE offset half a body-width up and to the left behind it, painted as a translucent ghost (much paler washes, the front figure showing through) but with its own dark ink outline. Both figures in the same walking pose. Ivory-white, pale gold, slate-grey ink. Tag: A TRANSLUCENT DOUBLE — at 40 px the silhouette has two heads and two sets of legs, a doubled outline.

A sanctum sentinel: a squat standing STONE PILLAR, slightly tapered, with ONE HUGE OPEN EYE carved into its upper face — a wide almond eye with a gold iris and a dark pupil, looking right — and a few gold-inlaid lines below it; no limbs, no face beyond the eye. Pale slate-grey stone with chalk-white lit side, gold accent, no glow. Tag: A STONE EYE — a blunt monolith with an eye. Reads at 40 px; clearly not the bell sentinel (which is a humanoid with a bell head).

The Mirror King facing right, LARGER than the warden: a tall regal figure whose whole body is a DARK MIRROR (flat blue-black, all channels low, never saturated blue) with silvered cyan-white edge highlights (green at least as high as blue), wearing a long slate-and-gold robe and a tall spiked GOLD CROWN, holding a tall sceptre topped with a round polished hand-mirror, a single pale crack across the featureless face. Gold, ivory, blue-black. Tag: BOSS — crowned, mirror sceptre, the hero's dark reflection made king. Reads at 64 px.

Key art, landscape, NO TEXT: the anime fighter and rogue seen from behind, small at the bottom of the frame, standing at the mouth of a great dark stair descending into an olive-umber warren; a faint teal fen glow and a distant indigo crypt light stacked deeper below; the whole painted as loose 1980s anime watercolour key art with bold ink, white paper breathing through at the top. Chiaroscuro, upper-left key light, muted field with jewel accents.

Older flagstone floor: small irregular cobble-like stones, deeper mortar gaps, a little grit between stones. Same stone and value range as the other floors. Seamless when tiled.

Same wall FRONT FACE as wall_face_0 (same capstone ledge on top, same courses) but with different block lengths and one block chipped and a small dark hole. Seamless left-to-right and interchangeable with wall_face_0.

The TOP of a thick dungeon wall seen straight down: the upper surface of rough stone blocks, dark and unlit (it is the mass above the rooms), large blocks with dark cracks, low contrast, darker than the floor. Seamless in every direction.

A heavy iron PORTCULLIS set in a stone arch, seen front-on in the wall: a round stone arch frame with voussoir blocks, and inside it a dark opening crossed by a grid of thick iron bars (4 vertical, 3 horizontal) with rivets at the crossings. The dark opening behind the bars is the darkest value.

Stone stairs going DOWN into darkness, seen from above: four stone steps, each narrower and darker than the one above it, the bottom falling into near-black; a stone frame on the left and right. Top step lightest.
Stone stairs going UP, seen from above: four stone steps, lit edges on each step front, the top step the lightest value, stone side walls left and right.

Dark still dungeon water, seen from above: a deep dark liquid surface with 3-4 horizontal RIPPLE LINES (each a short 3-6 pixel lighter dash, clearly separated) and 2 single-pixel bright glints; the rest calm flat dark with a subtle 2-tone band.
